g.text: Promo codes · Manager management and customer validation
Inserts with its discount, validity window and usage cap
Validity window or cap gets adjusted. The code itself
isn't rewritten: it's already in people's hands
Enters the promo code in the cart
[The discounted total would fall below the chargeable minimum]
Stripe won't charge below its minimum.
Better to say so here than fail at checkout
200 with the discount and the resulting total
POST /orders, alongside the stock hold, and is released when the
order is paid, cancelled or expires. Between validation and
checkout the last use may have been taken by someone else: that's
why checkout re-checks it and may respond 409 for the coupon.
